svg.title: Nine stores, one vocabulary
svg.desc: On the left, nine agents with where each keeps its history and in what format: antigravity, ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli, sqlite + jsonl; claude-code, ~/.claude, jsonl; codex, ~/.codex, jsonl + sqlite; copilot, ~/.copilot, jsonl + sqlite; grok, ~/.grok, jsonl; hermes, ~/.hermes, sqlite; kimi-code, ~/.kimi-code, jsonl; opencode, ~/.local/share/opencode, sqlite; pi, ~/.pi, jsonl. Each is read by its own adapter. Their nine lines meet in rosettad, which normalizes them, and one line leaves for a single table, TimelineEntry, with seven kinds: user, a prompt; agent, a reply; thinking, reasoning; tool_use, 28 actions; collaboration, among agents; notice, what changed; summary, a compaction. The same rows for every agent.
